# SQ-1600: a verified command sequence for Adventureland (adv01.dat, the
# first title in Adventure International's classic Scott Adams series),
# reconstructed by decompiling the real database's action table
# (`scott::decompile::decompile_all` on adv01.dat -- every room, item, verb,
# noun, condition and effect) and then booting the real game headlessly
# through ScottSession, submitting each command and checking its actual
# printed reply against the decompiled conditions before adding it here
# (crates/app/tests/suites/walkthrough_adventureland.rs). No published
# walkthrough or solution file was consulted for this one -- it is this
# project's own derived list of literal game commands, worked out directly
# from the action table and confirmed turn by turn against the real
# interpreter, produced for automated regression testing.
#
# Format: one command per line; blank lines and `#`-comment lines are
# ignored. Every command is submitted as an ordinary typed line -- Scott
# Adams games (outside a US S.A.G.A. picture-show sequence, which this
# title never enters) take no keypress-only input.
#
# The harness injects a host Save State/Restore State persistence check
# right after the `drop keys` below (back in the treasure room having just
# deposited the Pot of Rubies and the skeleton keys, holding nothing more
# exotic than the lit^H^H^Hunlit lamp and a full water bottle) -- see that
# file's CHECKPOINT_AFTER_COMMAND doc.
#
# The walkthrough's shape, for anyone reading the raw command list: get the
# axe and immediately visit the quicksand bog to say the magic word BUNYON
# (this relocates both the axe and, on the next turn, the Blue Ox statue to
# the hidden grove -- Paul Bunyan's own joke, and the only way to trigger
# it, since the general "say bunyon anywhere" action does not also move the
# ox); swim out of the bog (it has no ordinary exit); collect the axe, the
# jewelled fruit and the ox from the grove; fetch the skeleton keys from the
# cypress treetop BEFORE felling the tree (climbing it afterwards enters the
# stump/treasure-room instead); chop the tree down and descend into the
# stump to find the lamp, a full water bottle and the Pot of Rubies; unlock
# the door beyond with the keys; fetch the flint & steel from the ledge
# below the bottomless hole (needed to light both the lamp and, later, the
# bottled gas); dive underground with mud on (protection against the
# African bees and the chiggers) to net a bottle of bees (poke an air hole
# in it or they suffocate) and the Royal Honey; drop the bees on the
# sleeping dragon in the meadow to make it flee, dropping the Dragon Eggs
# (a SECOND `drop bees`, once the dragon is gone, is the general case that
# empties the bottle back out rather than the dragon-specific one); rub the
# lamp (unlit!) exactly twice for the Genie's gifts -- a third rub turns it
# hostile and takes a treasure back; fill the wine bladder with swamp gas,
# carry it to the royal chamber and light it there (never while carrying
# it) to blow a hole in the bricked-up window and loosen fire bricks;
# scream at the black bear guarding the ledge to startle it off rather than
# fighting it, freeing the Magic Mirror and, across the throne room, the
# Gold Crown; fetch the Persian Rug from the maze of pits -- carrying it and
# saying AWAY teleports between the meadow and the maze, the ONLY way in or
# out of that whole underground cluster, which has no other route back to
# the cavern; dam the lava at the bottom of the chasm with the bricks to
# reveal the Firestone (too hot to hold), pour water on it to cool it, and
# collect the Golden Net that was sitting right there; the Magic Mirror can
# only be dropped safely in the same room as the (already-dropped) rug, or
# it shatters; and finally net the Golden Fish at the lake shore (carrying
# both the net and a full water bottle defeats its two separate decay
# risks -- escaping back to the lake, and simply dying of thirst) for the
# thirteenth and last treasure, then say SCORE for the game's own ending.
#

east
east
get axe
north
say bunyon
swim
west
south
